title: Sensei Provider Port Capabilities V1
description: The O2 capability snapshot returned by a provider's self-description (Describe()). This is untrusted provider self-description: it proves only that a provider claims support for the listed operations, never eligibility, authority, or routing.
$comment: Canonical producer/owner: globulario/sensei, golang/architecture/providerport. A capability claim grants nothing beyond eligibility to be asked; actual eligibility to invoke a provider belongs to the caller/configuration layer, out of O2 scope (docs/design/provider-neutral-execution-port-o2.md hard law 2).

capabilities_digest_sha256.$comment: Self-referential semantic digest of this document with this field zeroed before hashing (closureprotocol.SemanticDigest convention).
